name: 18509 · Scranton, PA
findings: ZIP 18509 (Scranton) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18509 (Scranton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18509 (Scranton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
